sloka: चपला ह्यविनीताश्च चलचित्ताश्च वानराः ।न सहिष्यन्ति ते नादं सिंहनादमिव द्विपाः ।। ६.५७.९ ।।।।
transliteration: capalā hyavinītāśca calacittāśca vānarāḥ ।na sahiṣyanti te nādaṁ siṁhanādamiva dvipāḥ ।। 6.57.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "Vanaras, who are fickle minded, undisciplined and volatile, will not endure the roar of lions of glowing Rakshasas."
